normal.text: Steam probably does more than any other storefront to funnel the right games to the right users. Playstation shows me any old shit. Steam knows what I like. It has the best meta tagging. normal.name: Spooky D (Sunny D)
normal.text: Monkey Island 2 is an absolute gem. You're missing out. There's a whole bunch of DOS games I've never played. I held so dearly onto Amiga gaming, that I was loathe to try anything else. That said, I've never played the "Best" Ultima. Ultima IV - Quest of The Avatar. Played UV & UVI loads tho.
normal.media: image: And I wasn't overly taken by Ultima VII. Much preferred Ultima V and Ultima VI. Enjoyed Ultima's VIII & VIIII much, much more than The "Bestest" one Sheven.

normal.name: Arkveveen
normal.text: I think Townfall hits my nostalgia so hard because it takes place in the 90s! In 1996! I was growing up in the 90s, after all. It's just a shame that I didn't really see any retro video game stuff in Silent Hill: Townfall, but it was retro tech that appeared to be lovingly rendered.
